prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A young man stands outdoors in a sunlit, urban park setting, holding up a modern smartphone with a bright orange screen that boldly displays the text “9600 GB” in large black letters. He wears a light yellow, short-sleeved, collared knit shirt with subtle horizontal stripes, exuding a casual, approachable vibe. His brown hair is neatly styled, and he smiles gently, looking directly at the camera with a confident yet friendly expression. His left hand gestures slightly, as if emphasizing the impressive storage capacity shown on the phone. The background is softly blurred, featuring hints of green foliage and the light gray facade of a contemporary building, creating a pleasant bokeh effect that draws focus to the subject. The color palette is warm and inviting, dominated by yellows, greens, and soft neutrals, with the vivid orange of the phone screen providing a striking focal point. The lighting is natural and even, suggesting a bright, clear day. The composition is centered and intimate, with a shallow depth of field and a slight cinematic quality, as if captured with a medium lens at eye level, emphasizing both the product and the cheerful demeanor of the presenter.
